content: Řḥukm issaggʷaden x Ninwa. Adlis n řewḥiy n Naḥum, Alquci.
Alif. - Arebbi ittasmen u SIDI intaqam, SIDI d aneqqam u Netta d bab n wesɛar. SIDI d aneqqam i řɛedyan nnes, Netta igga řɛedyan jar tiṭṭawin nnes.
SIDI ɣares ttasiɛ n řxaḍar u jjehd nnes imɣar u Netta war ittbarri ɛemmarṣ wenni itteggen ddenb. Bit. Abrid n SIDI di tḥaryaḍt u deg usemmiḍ, iseynuten aqa aten d taɛejjajt n iḍaren nnes.
Gimel. - Netta iwebbex řebḥar, ittarra i-t yuẓeɣ, marra iɣezran ittejja i-ten ttaẓɣen. Dalit. Bacan d Karmal sřawen, uřa d nnuwar n Lubnan isřaw.
Hi. - Idurar ttarjijin zzayes, u tiwririn fessyent, Waw. u tammurt tᵉttwassgeɛɛed-dd zzat i wudem nnes, uřa d marra wi xas izeddɣen!
Zayin. - Wi izemmaren ad iqqim ibedd zzat i wesxeḍ nnes, u wi izemmaren ad ikkar zzat i řḥaduq n weɣḍab nnes? Xit. Asɛar nnes ittwakebb-dd am tmessi u tiṣuḍar ttwaqeǧɛent-i-dd zzayes.
Tit. - Icna SIDI i ddurri deg wass n řeḥṣaret. Yud. Netta issen marra inni ɣares yarekkwařen.
Kaf. - S yict n řḥemřet ifeyyḍen ad yuqa amcan nnes u řɛedyan nnes ad ten iḍfar, ař ɣa yadfen ɣar taǧest.
Mim. - Min txarrṣem xenni x SIDI? Netta ad t iqḍa qaɛ. Aɣufi war dd-ittis martayen.
Aqa nitni ttwamuden ɛad am cbarq ak-d isennanen, u ɣellan am yimescaren, ammu i ɣa ttwaccen nitni qaɛ am uřum yuẓɣen.
Zzayek i dd-iffeɣ wenni ittxarrṣen di min war iḥřin x SIDI, amcawar i war isekkwin walu.
Ammu issawař SIDI: Waxxa nitni ttfeřḥen u ǧan deg waṭṭas, waxxa amenni nitni ad ttwaqessen u netta ad iɛdu. Waxxa necc ggiɣ xak aɣiř, maca necc war xak tteggeɣ aɣiř ɛad.
Řexxu ad arẓeɣ azayřu nnes i xak immarsen, u Necc ad carrgeɣ tisɣunin nnec.
SIDI iweṣṣa xak, aqa war zzayek ittiři ɛad ḥed s yisem nnec. Necc ad qeḍɛeɣ řexyařat ineqcen d řexyařat ifesyen zi taddart nnec. Necc ad ggeɣ anḍeř nnec, maɣar ufiɣ cek tefsused.

footnotes.text: Naḥum- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘Afewwej’ niɣ ‘Amfewwej’.

afessar - adlis n Naḥum dayes ijj n uṣettef ‘AlifBat’. Man aya ixs ad yini aqa ɛřayen marra isekkilen (lḥuruf) n Tɛibranit ttwassxeddmen di tira-ya, ijj awarni i wenneɣni, kuř ijj di nnubet nnes. Ntaf ɣar umezwaru n kuř tasɣart ijj n usekkil (ijj n lḥarf) n lḥuruf n alifBat n Tmaziɣt ɣar uzeǧif n wawař amezwaru n ijj n wezyen n wawařen n wedlis. Ittwaf usettef-a waha deg Wedlis Iqeddsen n SIDI AREBBI, war iǧi deg uřa d ijj n wedlis nneɣni di Ccarq Amerwasu.
iseynuten ...- am mammec iggur bnadem di tɛejjact, ammu iggur SIDI AREBBI x iseynuten n ijenwan.
Bacan d Karmal ... Lubnan- aqa-ten d jjwayeh s řɣiǧet aṭṭas deg wussan n zic.
